title: The Glasshouse

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: Even in winter, things grow in our glasshouse, where the sun is trapped and kept warm.

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: We've been growing seedlings for spring. Would you please measure them with these blocks?

steps.speaker: elias
steps.prompt: Stack blocks beside each seedling until the stack is just as tall.
steps.question: tallest

older.question: difference
older.prompt: Measure each seedling with the blocks. Then we'll compare them.

feedback.all_good: Now we know how tall each one is. Growing slowly, but growing!

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: Growing things teaches us patience. We can't hurry a seed. We can only care for it, and wait.

journal_line: I measured the seedlings in the monastery glasshouse.
